anatomyReview.notes: Right-facing bird-only, two folded wings far side occluded, one head/bill/two feet; short tail, cream supercilium and small black/pale wing patch, no broad white bars. Full original and ivory alpha-composite individually inspected; expert/native review pending.

Singing on low twig, one open bill/two mandibles, two folded wings far side occluded and two gripping feet. Twig/heath end below bird/fade at base, no top crop. Full original and ivory alpha-composite individually inspected; expert/native review pending.

Straight front, one central bill, two folded wings and feet, finely streaked breast/plain belly and rounded crest. Full original and ivory alpha-composite individually inspected; expert/native review pending.

Strict rear with hidden bill/eyes, two folded wings/two feet; cream supercilia meet at nape, short tail and streaked brown back. Full original and ivory alpha-composite individually inspected; expert/native review pending.

Centered ventral, two broad spread wings, buff-gray coverts and brown remiges without broad white wingbars, streaked breast/plain belly, short tail, one head/bill/two tucked feet. Full original and ivory alpha-composite individually inspected; expert/native review pending.
